summary: Brother of James Tuthill (John's 8th-great-grand-uncle); his marriage to Hannah Reeve was merged into James's in the Ancestry tree.
bio:
Full brother of James, so the Wells/Tuthill descent and the Society of Colonial Wars route via William Wells survive the James-versus-Joshua confusion.

Akerly: Joshua Tuthill of Cutchogue, b. 1690, d. 2 June 1782, married Hannah, daughter of Maj. James Reeve of Mattituck. Their children were James (1727), Samuel, John of Speonk (1728), Isaac, Deborah (m. Elijah Terry), Hannah, Deliverance and possibly Daniel ([R4-S1]).
sources: [R4-S1] L. D. Akerly, The Tuthill Family of Tharston, Norfolk Co., England, and Southold, Suffolk Co., New York (1898), pp. 6-9 (nos. 2-11) (secondary) https://archive.org/details/tuthillfamilyoft00aker
